import sys, heapq

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if not data:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)
n = data[0]
sizes = data[1:1+n]

if n == 0:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)

heapq.heapify(sizes)
total = 0
while len(sizes) > 1:
    a = heapq.heappop(sizes)
    b = heapq.heappop(sizes)
    s = a + b
    total += s
    heapq.heappush(sizes, s)

print(total)
